claims.statement: Auth context is provided by useAuth.tsx (not .ts) in frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.tsx exposing { user, isAuthenticated, login, logout, loading }; consumed by App.tsx, Layout.tsx, and every page that needs role/identity.

Data-fetch hooks wrap TanStack Query by domain — useCatalogs reads the bootstrap catalogs; useAuditLogs reads audit logs; driver/forwarder/financial/salary/tire/notification/dashboard queries are split into per-domain files (useDriverQueries, useForwarderQueries, useFinancialQueries, useSalaryQueries, useTireQueries, useNotificationQueries, useDashboardQueries); useChatbotMetrics, useAppSettings, useGpsSettings, useLlmSettings cover admin-only surfaces; useQueries is a generic data-fetch helper and useCRUD is a generic CRUD factory against the API client.

Form hooks orchestrate the trip-form state machine: useTripForm owns legs/fuel mode/allocations/allowance/revenue/expenses/instructions and validates against backend Zod schemas; useTripFormContext.tsx provides the React context so deeply-nested trip cards under components/trip/ can read+dispatch; use-trip-form-submit runs the submit pipeline and invalidates caches; tripFormDispatchUtils provides reducer-style dispatch helpers; useDirtyGuard warns on back-navigation.

UI helper hooks include useClickOutside (dropdown/modal dismissal), useBackShortcut (Escape + hardware back with dirty-guard), useMonth.tsx (selected-month context for dashboard/P&L), usePrefersReducedMotion (ReducedMotionProvider), useMediaQuery (SSR-safe media query), useFocusDeepLink, useFocusTrap, usePersistedContainerType (localStorage), useSyncedState, usePushNotifications (service-worker push), useAgentOpenable / useAgentChat (agent drawer + streaming chat), and animation hooks under animations/ (useBottomNavAnimations, useSidebarAnimations, useTopbarEntrance, useAnimatedOverlay).
Tests colocate with hooks — useAuth.test.tsx, useAgentChat.test.ts, useBottomNavAnimations.test.tsx, use-trip-form-submit.test.ts; new hooks should add tests in the same folder.
